node_definition.done_when: Read the plan section with read_plan(view='section', section='s10') before starting; it is the authority. The obligation kinds are composed in reckon/crew/obligations.py. Use the selector promotion already uses, select_review_for_head, and do not write a second selector. In a new tests/test_review_obligation_reads_the_head.py, using a synthesised temporary repository and a temporary configuration home (never the real ones), assert two cases: a stored review at an earlier head with the worktree advanced past it reads review-missing naming both heads, never review-ready; and a review stored at the current head reads review-ready. Execute the named negative control. The gate is the new test plus every test file under tests/ that names review-ready, review-missing, obligations( or select_review_for_head, found by a text search. Run it at base and at head and list the files in the manifest. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion/review-obligation-reads-the-head.html records the change. Run `date -u` first and treat that instant as your start; your deadline is 60 minutes later. Write your manifest before starting any long command. Run both gate arms with pytest-xdist (-n 8 --timeout=300), never serially. Run the base arm, from a `git archive` extraction of your base under /tmp in a directory named for this run, and then the head arm, each in the foreground: a background command dies when your turn ends. Keep the gate to the test files that reach your change, tens of files rather than hundreds. Each arm uses its own basetemp outside any repository and writes to its own new log path, which it never overwrites. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder. Each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed Python paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
node_definition.goal: Land section 10 of scoring-should-stop-a-promotion as the plan states it: the review-ready and review-missing obligations read the review that select_review_for_head selects for the run's current worktree head, so a head that moved past its review reads review-missing naming both heads.
